productionBaseline.terminalResourcePolicyCanaryModule: absent in both PH-001 baseline and RED

contractStrengthening.leaseAuthenticity: WsRouter consumes only the runtime-unforgeable lease issued by TerminalResourcePolicyCanary; a structurally identical clone is rejected. The frontend issuer requires trusted evidence, stable profile and exact N capability/compiler schema, validates identity, and supplies an explicit scheduler current target; no test-local Symbol is used. Forged/stale rejection is state-preserving.
contractStrengthening.actualHeadlessState: Tests seed SessionManager.sessions with real headlessOutputQueue instances configured from the authoritative 8MiB/actual chunk limits and pendingHeadlessOutputs; old byteLength/queuedAt/expiresAt/policyGeneration/ready/recoveryGeneration/exactlyOnceKey/order and another session are read directly from SessionManager state.
contractStrengthening.forbiddenEffects: AC-3 seeds non-empty A/B transport queues, actual headless queues, connection identities, restore authority keys and PTY producer counters; independent pre/post hashes, sent frames, close codes and actual RuntimeConfigStore registry objects supplement lifecycle counters.
contractStrengthening.atomicFailure: AC-5 uses a valid lease for a missing actual SessionManager session as the real second-adapter failure; no testFault switch exists. The preceding WS transition returns to its pre-batch legacy state, target B remains candidate, queues/producers/authority hashes remain identical and no missing session is synthesized.
contractStrengthening.ledger: Capacity+K still verifies exact latest-N sequence/drop isolation and now requires exact payload-free key allowlist, all policy/version/previous-next/accepted/reason/rollback fields, transition and requested/draining/closed events, frozen snapshot/entries/nested targets and mutation rejection.
contractStrengthening.rollbackGeneration: Target A records candidate generation, switches immediately to a distinct monotonic legacy generation, retains the old generation on queued output, and uses the new generation for post-rollback admission. Rollback closes immediately after the final pre-rollback candidate entry callback without waiting on later legacy output, preventing endless-output starvation; generation remains absent from wire payloads.
